images.caption: Fig. 1:Training of the BiSAT tokenizer and BiSAT-TTS. (a) The acoustic and semantic branches are jointly trained with mel-spectrogram reconstruction and CTC, respectively. A shared-index vector quantizer selects one entry per frame from each codebook to create a single code stream. A commitment loss is used to keep both encoder outputs close to these entries. (b1) The text-speech LM predicts each speech code and the final EOS from the text tokens and the preceding codes. (b2) The acoustic decoder predicts the flow-matching velocity from the noisy interpolant, conditioned on the codes, a prompt mel spectrogram, and a speaker condition. At inference, an Euler ODE solver generates the mel spectrogram, and the frozen vocoder converts it into a waveform.
